explanation: Only fires at the GO step, about 9-10, when the previous trial was a2 reaching S2 by the common transition and it was rewarded, and only around trials 70-85 of the episode. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, 0 after a rare transition, no reward or an a1 choice, and only 0-2 for the same a2-common-rewarded case earlier in the episode (before trial ~70) or late (trial ~90 or later).
